name: NetraAI Prior Authorization Agent
description: AI-powered prior authorization automation agent that extracts clinical evidence from diagnostic results and generates complete prior auth packets. Reduces processing time by 80% and handles the $31B annual prior auth burden. Features 11 specialized MCP tools spanning 5 AI diagnostic models, FHIR R4 operations, longitudinal trend analysis, and CMS-0057-F compliant prior auth generation.

supported_interfaces.description: Server-Sent Events for streaming real-time diagnostic progress

skills.name: Prior Authorization Automation
skills.description: Automates the complete CMS-0057-F compliant prior authorization workflow by extracting clinical evidence from diagnostic results, building longitudinal trend analysis via Tool 9, and generating FHIR R4 Bundle submission-ready prior auth packets with approval likelihood scoring.
examples: Generate prior authorization for diabetic retinopathy screening for patient ID 12345
Create prior auth packet for cataract surgery based on diagnostic results
Extract clinical evidence for anemia treatment authorization
Process prior auth for mental health services with diagnostic support
Generate IV iron infusion prior auth with treatment failure documentation
Create urgent prior auth for proliferative DR with anti-VEGF indication

skills.name: Clinical Evidence Extraction
skills.description: Extracts and structures clinical evidence from diagnostic results, lab reports, and imaging studies to support prior authorization requests. Uses LOINC-coded FHIR Observations.
examples: Extract hemoglobin levels and anemia severity from diagnostic results
Structure diabetic retinopathy findings for insurance submission
Compile mental health PHQ-9 assessment scores for treatment authorization
Extract UPDRS motor scores for Parkinson's prior auth

skills.name: Payer Requirements Matching
skills.description: Matches patient clinical data against specific payer requirements and criteria for various medical services and treatments across 8 major insurance providers.
examples: Check if patient meets Medicare criteria for diabetic retinopathy screening
Validate Aetna requirements for cataract surgery authorization
Match clinical findings to Medicaid prior auth criteria
Check UnitedHealthcare requirements for Parkinson's neurological assessment

skills.name: Multi-Diagnostic Workflow Orchestration
skills.description: Intelligently coordinates multiple diagnostic tools based on patient chief complaint. Routes: fatigue -> Anemia+Mental Health, vision -> Cataract+DR, tremor -> Parkinsons, diabetes -> DR+Anemia, screening -> comprehensive.
examples: Run fatigue workup for elderly female patient with vision complaints
Coordinate comprehensive screening workflow for diabetic patient
Orchestrate vision screening battery for prior auth evidence
Run tremor assessment workflow for Parkinson's prior authorization

skills.name: FHIR R4 Integration
skills.description: Integrates with FHIR R4 compliant systems via 3 tools: get_patient_fhir for demographics, create_fhir_observation to persist results, and query_patient_timeline to retrieve longitudinal history for trend analysis and prior auth evidence.
examples: Retrieve patient demographics and medical history from FHIR server
Store diagnostic results as FHIR DiagnosticReport resources in Supabase
Query patient timeline for last 10 diagnostic reports for trend analysis
Create LOINC-coded FHIR Observation from hemoglobin measurement

skills.name: Longitudinal Diagnostic Trend Analysis
skills.description: Compares diagnostic results over time across all 5 disease areas to identify worsening trends. Uses Stanford HAI (2026) methodology. Powers prior auth medical necessity with High evidence level (+30 approval score boost).
examples: Compare anemia hemoglobin levels over last 90 days to prove oral iron failure
Show DR progression over 6 months for laser photocoagulation justification
Track PHQ-9 scores to document worsening depression requiring medication change
Compare UPDRS scores to show Parkinson's progression for DBS evaluation
skills.research_backing: Stanford HAI: Advancing Responsible Healthcare AI with Longitudinal EHR Datasets (2026)

scopes.patient:write: Write diagnostic results as FHIR Observations

bearer_jwt.description: Supabase JWT for direct service-to-service calls
